instruction: Use Abaqus via the Command Line Interface (CLI) to perform a simply supported beam analysis under a uniformly distributed load. Use the N-mm-MPa unit system. Part: Create a 3D Deformable Solid part using Extrusion. Sketch a 10 mm x 10 mm rectangle in the Y-Z plane (Y from 0 to 10, Z from 0 to 10). Extrude along the global X-axis to a length of 200 mm. This creates a beam with cross-section 10 mm x 10 mm and span 200 mm. Property: Create a material named Steel. Set Young's modulus E = 210000 MPa and Poisson's ratio nu = 0.3. Create a Solid Homogeneous section and assign it to the entire beam. Assembly: Create one dependent instance of the beam. Step: Create a Static, General step named Step-Load. Load: Create a reference point RP-1 at the geometric center of the left end face (X = 0, Y = 5 mm, Z = 5 mm) and couple it kinematically to that end face. Create a reference point RP-2 at the geometric center of the right end face (X = 200 mm, Y = 5 mm, Z = 5 mm) and couple it kinematically to that end face. At RP-1, constrain U1 = U2 = U3 = 0 and UR2 = UR3 = 0 to model a pinned support that allows rotation about the beam axis (UR1). At RP-2, constrain U2 = U3 = 0 and UR2 = UR3 = 0 to model a roller support that allows axial motion (U1) and rotation about the beam axis (UR1). Apply a pressure of 0.1 MPa downward on the beam top surface (the face at Y = 10 mm). This loading is equivalent to a uniformly distributed load q = 1 N/mm. Mesh: Apply a global seed size of 5 mm. Assign element type C3D8R and generate the mesh. Job: Create a job named Job-Beam, submit it for analysis, and wait for successful completion. Visualization: Query the U2 displacement (deflection) at the bottom midpoint of the span (X = 100 mm, Y = 0 mm, Z = 5 mm). Query the maximum Mises stress at the midspan section (X approximately 100 mm). Save: Save the model database to C:\Users\user\Desktop\Job-Beam.cae and ensure the output database is generated as C:\Users\user\Desktop\Job-Beam.odb. [Software] To start Abaqus/CAE, run `C:\SIMULIA\EstProducts\2023\win_b64\resources\install\cmdDirFeature\launcher.bat cae` (adjust path to your install).
